openings.claim: Keep surname dividers; update behind-desk exceptions whenever books move and record household-name discrepancies.
openings.discriminator: Verified addresses reduce second searches; persistent peak delays favor congestion.
openings.probe: Bounded paper trial: record mappings, current locations, second searches, queues, preparation and reconciliation time.
openings.uncertainty: Update capacity and ownership verification are unspecified; benefit untested.

openings.claim: Reconcile exceptions, freeze their evening locations, and retain new arrivals on the cart.
openings.discriminator: Stable addresses reduce searches; unchanged delays concentrated in household mismatches favor misfiling.
openings.probe: Time a bounded evening trial; record discrepancies and cart crowding. Reject feasibility above ten total preparation-and-correction minutes.
openings.uncertainty: Reconciliation time, cart capacity and existing ownership verification are unknown.

openings.claim: Cart retrieval may outperform shelving; ten fast synthetic pickups defeat universal shelving superiority.
openings.discriminator: Matched cohorts retain an advantage; slower retrieval, correctness loss or capacity limits defeat it.
openings.probe: Observe cart and shelf pickups with arrival volume and book size recorded; unmatched comparisons remain inconclusive.
openings.uncertainty: Selection effects, comparable cohorts and capacity remain unknown; routine retention unproven.

openings.claim: Separate waiting for the sole clerk from retrieval duration.
openings.discriminator: Peak delays with direct retrieval favor congestion; negligible waiting favors location errors.
openings.probe: Anonymous encounter timestamps: arrival, service start, handoff; compare peak/off-peak and direct/second searches.
openings.uncertainty: Recording burden and whether the success clock starts at arrival are unresolved.

lineage.reason: Move-linked updates and household mapping retained.
Cart/shelf comparison and selection rival retained.
Location freezing is distinct from live updates.

decision: Compare bounded probes; findings are synthetic, not tested effects. Only the existing clerk hands off verified correct holds; names/contact details stay behind desk; use two shelves, one cart and existing paper; daily preparation including setup stays within ten clerk-minutes. Require 95% of available pickups within two minutes and zero wrong-reader handoffs; neither is established. Reader uncertainty may matter, but interview representativeness is unknown.
